name: Firing Line
description: A first-person shooter: walk, sprint, crouch, aim down sights, hip and aimed fire, reloads and three weapons against bots that search, take cover, retreat when hurt and call for reinforcements. One scene, one Game Manager with a game-type list (one against all, team deathmatch, free for all, co-op): put the manager and some fighters in any scene and it plays. Online too: co-op against a horde of bots, or eight against eight with bots in the empty seats (Play › Multiplayer).
